name: set_expression
description: Replace an expression (5 fields or a macro).

name: set_field
description: Replace one field of an expression: minute, hour, day, month or weekday.

name: add_cron
description: Add an expression; it gets the next free id (c1, c2, …).

name: reorder_crons
description: Move an expression to index (0 is first).

name: set_timezone
description: Change the timezone label of an expression (runs stay in UTC).

name: set_expected_next
description: Set the ISO time an expression's first run should be, or "" to clear it.

name: explain
description: An expression's English description, each field's values and its next 5 runs.

name: next_runs
description: The next count runs of an expression (at most 100), as UTC ISO times.
